bio.text: Kristen McDonald Rivet represents Michigan's 8th Congressional District, which includes Genesee, Saginaw, Bay and Midland counties, in the U.S. House of Representatives.
Before Congress she served in the Michigan State Senate.
Earlier in her career she was Executive Director of Michigan Head Start, Chief of Staff of the Michigan Department of Education, and Vice President of The Skillman Foundation.
